name: Conversion-focused sites for local trades, prospected with AI
one_liner: Use an AI agent to find local service businesses with strong Google reviews but weak or missing websites, then sell them a simple one-page site built to get calls.
customer: Small local service businesses such as plumbers, roofers, HVAC, pest control and tyre shops
offer: A mobile-first, one-page website with one call to action, reviews placed near the top and tap-to-call, plus ongoing conversion work
how_it_makes_money: A setup fee plus a monthly retainer. The transcript gives no exact price, but says '300 customers is a million-dollar business', which implies about $3.3K per customer per year
startup_cost: low (AI agent and site builder subscriptions; no amount stated)
time_to_first_revenue: unknown; the agent builds demo sites in 20-30 minutes, so outreach can start within days
evidence: 'We created a simple website with one call to action. And we went from zero to 80 grand this summer' (DlNWYzaL_F0)
'300 customers is a million-dollar business... every bit of it can be outsourced' (DlNWYzaL_F0)
'I spent $5,000 on my plumbing website and I can't track one piece of business' is a common complaint from these owners (DlNWYzaL_F0)
An agent found CS Automotive (300+ Google reviews, no website) and built it a site with booking in a 20-30 minute run (GZbjmWNmIkc)
risks: Cold outreach to trades has low reply rates
Free demo sites can be copied
The $80K result belongs to the client's business, not the agency

name: Done-for-you AI support agents for SMBs
one_liner: Set up AI customer-support or chat agents for small businesses and charge a monthly fee to keep them running.
customer: Local and small businesses with heavy customer enquiries
offer: An AI support agent trained on the business's own information, plus monitoring and automated monthly reports
how_it_makes_money: A $2-3K setup fee plus a $500-1,000/month retainer. Build cost was about $50
time_to_first_revenue: unknown (weeks, if you sell a template that is already built)
tools: Docspot or similar AI agent platform
evidence: 'People with zero coding skills are charging $2 to $3,000 to set this up... and $500 to $1,000 a month to keep running it' (22Jpzt683jw)
'What did that cost you all in? About 50 bucks' (22Jpzt683jw)
The founder's business makes over $1M a year in profit with 3 helpers; one client said the service would save them over $100K a year (22Jpzt683jw)
risks: Hallucination and GDPR liability in the UK and EU
The guest sells the platform, so his claims are biased

name: White-label GoHighLevel SaaS for one local niche
one_liner: Rebrand GoHighLevel as a CRM, booking and AI phone system for a single niche and sell it as a subscription.
customer: Local service businesses in one niche, such as med spas, dentists, pest control, roofers or bounce-house rental
offer: A niche-branded all-in-one CRM with marketing, booking, phone and AI features
how_it_makes_money: Monthly SaaS fees, with $97/month as the platform minimum and most resellers charging $200-500. The platform costs $497/month flat, so margins are high
evidence: Public SaaSpreneur awards tiers: gold = 100+ paying customers, platinum = 500+, diamond = 1,000+ (VOo3M3ZHUoA)
Napkin maths: 101 customers × $297 = about $30K/month against $497 in platform cost (VOo3M3ZHUoA)
risks: Revenue figures are estimates from public award tiers, not verified

name: Brand-and-subcontract home service company
one_liner: Run the brand, website, CRM and sales for a home service and pass every job to licensed subcontractors.
customer: Homeowners who need plumbing installs or cleaning
offer: Booked and managed home-service jobs, done by partner tradespeople
how_it_makes_money: Margin between the job price and what the subcontractor is paid
startup_cost: low (about $500 setup; about $300/month for tools plus about $180/month insurance)
time_to_first_revenue: days to weeks; the case reached $81K revenue in its third month (85 days in)
evidence: 'In August, we did 81,000 in revenue... 85 days', with $54K booked for September (9U4MCbfL8MQ)
'$500 of setup and we were ready to go'; all work subcontracted (9U4MCbfL8MQ)
The founder's earlier remote cleaning business sold for 'multiple six figures' (9U4MCbfL8MQ)
risks: Exact service and margins are not in the excerpt
UK Gas Safe and other licensing and liability rules

name: Commercial cleaning contracts
one_liner: Grow a cleaning business into recurring commercial facility contracts.
offer: Recurring cleaning contracts delivered by cleaning crews
how_it_makes_money: Monthly contract fees. One contract was $20K/month
startup_cost: low (no amount stated; the first cleans were done by the founder)
time_to_first_revenue: Residential revenue started within days; the $20K/month contract came about 60 days after joining a coaching programme
evidence: 'Averaged anywhere between three to four grand a month' from residential cleaning, while working a full-time job (ha_jQR9idBA)
'Within 60 days, we had scored our first $20,000 per month contract' (ha_jQR9idBA)
risks: The video promotes a coaching programme

name: Niche Etsy shop plus wholesale to local shops
one_liner: Sell one narrow handmade or vintage product on Etsy, then supply local gift shops on repeat orders.
customer: Etsy shoppers searching a narrow phrase; boutique and gift shops
offer: Niche handmade goods, such as dried flowers, cork maps or candles
how_it_makes_money: Product margin; candles have 60-70% gross margin, and shops reorder monthly
startup_cost: low (under $200 for a resale shop, about $500 for candles)
time_to_first_revenue: 2-6 weeks on Etsy; 2-4 weeks at local markets
evidence: (weak) Dried-flower shop started with $300 in a Melbourne bedroom, now about $10K/month (-B8E6i1JKfU)
(weak) Wax and Wick grew from about $1K/month to about $20K/month between 2015 and 2017 (-B8E6i1JKfU)

name: Trailer rental
one_liner: Rent out utility and enclosed trailers with mostly automated booking.
startup_cost: high ($35K for 10 used trailers; financing is available)
time_to_first_revenue: Immediate, because the founder bought an existing business
evidence: 'Revenue per month on average? 5,500 to 7,500'; 2-4 hours of work (68x7jFWbaE8)
Bought 10 trailers for $35K; under the previous owner they made only $28K a year (68x7jFWbaE8)
risks: Needs local storage and a physical presence

name: Kids' woodworking parties and classes
one_liner: Run hands-on woodworking birthday parties, camps and classes for children.
offer: Parties, holiday camps and weekly classes
how_it_makes_money: $75 per child per hour; camps; a $30K school contract
time_to_first_revenue: 1 week from a single Facebook post
evidence: $50.6K from March to July; $12K in spring-break week (qUORStgkuzc)
Startup cost under $450; first events booked the week after the post (qUORStgkuzc)
risks: Child safeguarding and insurance (DBS checks in the UK)
